# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_docs.py from the command line itself. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command and option of `sessionbridge`, as `--help` shows them in English. `sessionbridge COMMAND --help` shows the same text in the language you use, and the [user guide](user-guide.md) explains how the commands fit together.

`--json`, `--no-color` and `--lang`, listed under [`sessionbridge`](#sessionbridge), work with every command and anywhere on the line: `sessionbridge list --json`.

## Commands

- [`sessionbridge list`](#sessionbridge-list): List conversations (metadata only, without reading the messages).
- [`sessionbridge show`](#sessionbridge-show): Show every message of a session.
- [`sessionbridge convert`](#sessionbridge-convert): Continue a session in another assistant; --dry-run only shows the preview.
- [`sessionbridge export`](#sessionbridge-export): Export a session to a portable package.
- [`sessionbridge import`](#sessionbridge-import): Import a portable package into an assistant.
- [`sessionbridge resume`](#sessionbridge-resume): Open the session in its assistant, without sending any message.
- [`sessionbridge doctor`](#sessionbridge-doctor): Check which assistants can be read and written.
- [`sessionbridge undo`](#sessionbridge-undo): Undo a conversion while it is still safe to.
- [`sessionbridge recover`](#sessionbridge-recover): Complete an interrupted transfer from its verified archive.
- [`sessionbridge transfers`](#sessionbridge-transfers): List the transfers made.
- [`sessionbridge language`](#sessionbridge-language): Show or change Session Bridge's language; auto goes back to the system language.
- [`sessionbridge update`](#sessionbridge-update): Check for a newer version of Session Bridge and install it.
- [`sessionbridge profile`](#sessionbridge-profile): Manage each assistant's profiles.
- [`sessionbridge profile list`](#sessionbridge-profile-list): List the configured profiles.
- [`sessionbridge profile add`](#sessionbridge-profile-add): Add a local or WSL profile; needs arguments in non-interactive mode.
- [`sessionbridge wsl`](#sessionbridge-wsl): Inspect or prepare WSL explicitly.
- [`sessionbridge wsl status`](#sessionbridge-wsl-status): Show the available distributions without starting them.
- [`sessionbridge wsl install`](#sessionbridge-wsl-install): Install the helper in an explicitly chosen distribution.
- [`sessionbridge wsl start`](#sessionbridge-wsl-start): Start an explicitly chosen distribution.
- [`sessionbridge sync`](#sessionbridge-sync): Keep conversations synchronized between assistants.
- [`sessionbridge sync link`](#sessionbridge-sync-link): Link a session and turn on background sync.
- [`sessionbridge sync list`](#sessionbridge-sync-list): Show the links and their state.
- [`sessionbridge sync status`](#sessionbridge-sync-status): Show one link, or all of them if you give none.
- [`sessionbridge sync check`](#sessionbridge-sync-check): Capture new finished turns without opening any assistant.
- [`sessionbridge sync open`](#sessionbridge-sync-open): Prepare the current revision; the assistant opens only from a terminal.
- [`sessionbridge sync select`](#sessionbridge-sync-select): Choose which continuation to follow; the others are kept.
- [`sessionbridge sync pause`](#sessionbridge-sync-pause): Pause capturing this link.
- [`sessionbridge sync resume`](#sessionbridge-sync-resume): Resume capturing and start the worker if needed.
- [`sessionbridge sync unlink`](#sessionbridge-sync-unlink): Unlink without deleting files or native sessions.
- [`sessionbridge sync export`](#sessionbridge-sync-export): Export a revision to a portable package.
- [`sessionbridge sync backup`](#sessionbridge-sync-backup): Create a verified backup of the sync store.
- [`sessionbridge sync restore`](#sessionbridge-sync-restore): Restore Session Bridge's own history; it does not configure or open the assistants.
- [`sessionbridge sync detach`](#sessionbridge-sync-detach): Stop following an old source; its sessions, branches and files are kept.
- [`sessionbridge sync start`](#sessionbridge-sync-start): Start the local worker and check that it responds.
- [`sessionbridge sync stop`](#sessionbridge-sync-stop): Ask the worker to stop and wait for it to confirm.
- [`sessionbridge sync worker-status`](#sessionbridge-sync-worker-status): Show the worker's identity and its last heartbeat.
- [`sessionbridge sync run`](#sessionbridge-sync-run): Run capture in the foreground; Ctrl+C stops the worker.

## sessionbridge

Continue Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode conversations in any of them. With no command, a search opens: choose a conversation and continue it in another assistant.

```text
sessionbridge [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Return a versioned JSON response. |
| `--no-color` | Turn off terminal colors. |
| `--all-projects` | Search every folder, without highlighting the current one. |
| `--lang TEXT` | Language for this run only; `sessionbridge language` lists the ones there are. |
| `--version` | Show the installed version and exit. |
| `--install-completion` | Install completion for the current shell. |
| `--show-completion` | Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation. |

Commands: [`list`](#sessionbridge-list), [`show`](#sessionbridge-show), [`convert`](#sessionbridge-convert), [`export`](#sessionbridge-export), [`import`](#sessionbridge-import), [`resume`](#sessionbridge-resume), [`doctor`](#sessionbridge-doctor), [`undo`](#sessionbridge-undo), [`recover`](#sessionbridge-recover), [`transfers`](#sessionbridge-transfers), [`language`](#sessionbridge-language), [`update`](#sessionbridge-update), [`profile`](#sessionbridge-profile), [`wsl`](#sessionbridge-wsl), [`sync`](#sessionbridge-sync).

## sessionbridge list

List conversations (metadata only, without reading the messages).

```text
sessionbridge list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--tool TEXT`, `--from TEXT` | Only one assistant: claude, codex or opencode. |
| `--profile TEXT` | Only one profile, for example codex-win. |
| `--search TEXT` | Words from the title, the folder or the ID; accents do not matter. |
| `--cwd TEXT` | Working folder; the current one by default. |
| `--all-projects` | List sessions from every folder. |
| `--archived`, `--not-archived` | Only archived ones, or only those not archived. |
| `--parent TEXT` | Only subagents or forks of this session. |
| `--since TEXT` | Updated since this date (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `--until TEXT` | Updated until this date (YYYY-MM-DD). |

## sessionbridge show

Show every message of a session.

```text
sessionbridge show [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `KEY` | Session ID (profile:id, or a unique prefix). |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--snapshot` | Read a snapshot even if the session is still open. |

## sessionbridge convert

Continue a session in another assistant; --dry-run only shows the preview.

```text
sessionbridge convert [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `KEY` | Source session ID (profile:id, or a unique prefix). |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--to TEXT` | Target profile, for example codex-win. Required. |
| `--cwd TEXT` | Working folder in the target; the source's by default. |
| `--context TEXT` | current: since the last compaction; all: the full history. Default: `current`. |
| `--context-from TEXT` | ID of the message the context starts from. |
| `--snapshot` | Read a snapshot even if the session is still open. |
| `--mode TEXT` | native or handoff; handoff is always explicit. Default: `native`. |
| `--model TEXT` | Model to open the target with. |
| `--new-copy` | Create another copy even if one already exists. |
| `--dry-run` | Show the preview without writing anything. |
| `--variant TEXT` | Version to take if you edited messages; the current one by default. |
| `--resume` | Resume when done; requires a verified native conversion. |
| `--sync` | Keep this conversation linked automatically. |
| `--sync-name TEXT` | Name of the linked conversation. |

## sessionbridge export

Export a session to a portable package.

```text
sessionbridge export [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `KEY` | Session ID (profile:id, or a unique prefix). |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--output PATH` | Package to create. Required. |
| `--snapshot` | Read a snapshot even if the session is still open. |
| `--include-file PATH` | Extra file to include; repeatable. |

## sessionbridge import

Import a portable package into an assistant.

```text
sessionbridge import [OPTIONS] PACKAGE
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PACKAGE` | Package exported with sessionbridge export. |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--to TEXT` | Target profile, for example codex-win. Required. |
| `--cwd TEXT` | Working folder in the target. |
| `--context TEXT` | current: since the last compaction; all: the full history. Default: `current`. |
| `--context-from TEXT` | ID of the message the context starts from. |
| `--snapshot` | No effect on packages; accepted for compatibility. |
| `--mode TEXT` | native or handoff; handoff is always explicit. Default: `native`. |
| `--model TEXT` | Model to open the target with. |
| `--new-copy` | Create another copy even if one already exists. |
| `--dry-run` | Show the preview without writing anything. |
| `--variant TEXT` | Version to take if you edited messages; the current one by default. |

| `KEY` | ID of a session, a transfer or a synchronized conversation. |

## sessionbridge language

Show or change Session Bridge's language; auto goes back to the system language.

```text
sessionbridge language [OPTIONS] [en|es|auto]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `[en|es|auto]` | en, es or auto; with none, shows the current language. |

## sessionbridge update

Check for a newer version of Session Bridge and install it.

```text
sessionbridge update [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--check` | Only say whether a newer version is published. |
| `--yes` | Install without asking. |
| `--startup-check TEXT` | Look for updates when Session Bridge starts: on (the default) or off. |

## sessionbridge profile

Manage each assistant's profiles.

```text
sessionbridge profile [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Commands: [`list`](#sessionbridge-profile-list), [`add`](#sessionbridge-profile-add).

## sessionbridge profile list

List the configured profiles.

```text
sessionbridge profile list [OPTIONS]
```

## sessionbridge profile add

Add a local or WSL profile; needs arguments in non-interactive mode.

```text
sessionbridge profile add [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--id TEXT` | Profile identifier, for example codex-win. |
| `--tool TEXT` | Assistant: claude, codex or opencode. |
| `--home TEXT` | The assistant's data folder. |
| `--environment TEXT` | Environment: windows, wsl or posix. Default: `windows`. |
| `--distro TEXT` | WSL distribution. |
| `--executable TEXT` | The assistant's executable. |
| `--helper TEXT` | The helper's Python inside WSL. |
| `--version TEXT` | Installed version of the assistant. |
| `--machine TEXT` | Machine the profile belongs to. Default: `local`. |

## sessionbridge sync run

```text

```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--once` | Check once and exit. |
